title: As a developer, I can spin up an isolated sandbox with one API/SDK call and get a live environment in seconds
As a developer, I can set timeouts so sandboxes shut down automatically and stop billing when idle or done
As a developer, I can expose a port from the sandbox on a public preview URL to reach services running inside
As a developer, I can execute untrusted, AI-generated code without risking my own infrastructure
As a developer, I can run arbitrary shell commands and install packages inside the sandbox
As a developer, I can execute code in multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, and more) and get rich results back
As a developer, I can define custom sandbox templates or bring my own container image
As a developer, I can read, write, upload, and download files in the sandbox filesystem via the SDK
As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems
As a platform-engineer, I can restrict or allow the sandbox's network egress with explicit policy
As an ai-native user, I can give an agent a sandbox where host secrets and credentials are unreachable by the code it runs
As a developer, I can snapshot a sandbox and later restore or fork new sandboxes from that snapshot
As a developer, I can pause a running sandbox and resume it later with filesystem and memory state intact
As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts
As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits
As a developer, I can keep a sandbox session running for hours or days for long agent tasks
As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses
As a developer, I can start building with a free tier or included credits without talking to sales
As a developer, I can run a headless browser or full desktop environment inside the sandbox
As a developer, I can attach GPUs to sandboxed workloads
As an ai-native user, I can run coding agents like Claude Code or Codex inside the sandbox following the vendor's own recipe
As an ai-native user, my agent can provision its own sandbox, execute code, read the results, and tear it down — end to end without a human
